 'poly_exp': (lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**3+p[4]*np.exp(-p[5]*P), [14,-2,0.16,-0.04,0.01,1]),
 'sqrt_mix': (lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*P**3+p[4]*np.sqrt(P+p[5]), [14,-2,0.16,-0.04,0.01,1]),
 'gauss': (lambda p: p[0]+p[1]*P+p[2]*P**2+p[3]*np.exp(-p[4]*(P-p[5])**2), [14,-2,0.16,1,0.5,0]),
}
for name,(f,p0) in models.items():
    best=None
    for s in range(6):
        pp=np.array(p0,float)*(1+0.3*np.random.randn(len(p0))) if s else np.array(p0,float)
